{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of test orders: {len(test_orders)}')

# Check if 'completed' status is valid
completed_count = df['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)
print(f'Number of completed orders: {completed_count}')

# Check revenue dtype and example
print(f'Dtype of revenue: {df['revenue'].dtype}')
print(f'Sample of revenue values: {df['revenue'].head(10).tolist()}')

# Note: revenue is string with commas
# Confirm presence of -1 in customer_age
print(f'Number of -1 in customer_age: {df[df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count()}')"}
